name: Hari (tomatillo salsa verde cruda)
status: PRELIMINARY ESTIMATE — NOT COOKED OR TASTED
method: Rinse husked tomatillos; blend all ingredients to a loose pulp (keep some texture).
Rest 20 min, taste for acid and salt; adjust with lime or salt.
Hold cold; blend fresh every 2 days for colour.

sauce_spec.use: tacos, birria, 65 garnish; the Mexican-identity acid

food_safety: Raw produce: wash tomatillos, cilantro and chiles; keep at or below 5 °C; date-mark; discard per the written policy (assume 2 days for colour and safety margin).
estimates_label: All quantities, yields and shelf-life values are preliminary estimates until tested by a person in a kitchen.
